projects.title: Libsys
projects.description: LibSys is a library management system built with Django (Python). It allows for the efficient tracking of books and members, focusing on core lending functions: borrowing and returning. This web-based application simplifies library operations by providing a straightforward interface for managing resource availability and member loans.
projects.outcome: Reduced book-tracking time by automating member loans and returns

projects.title: Credit Card Advisor
projects.description: This Credit Card Advisor is an AI-powered conversational agent designed to help users find the best-fit credit cards based on their financial profile and spending habits. Built with Flask for the backend and a LangChain agent, it guides users through a series of questions to collect necessary information (monthly income, spending habits, preferred benefits, existing cards, and credit score), and then recommends suitable credit cards from a simulated database.
projects.outcome: Delivers personalised credit card recommendations via AI-powered conversation

projects.title: Job AI Bot & Automated Matcher
projects.description: An AI-powered job search automation system. Built with Playwright for headless job scraping across major career sites. Integrates Gemini AI APIs to summarize job listings, score them against a resume profile, categorize requirements, and dispatch automated email summaries via SMTP.
projects.outcome: Automated recruitment discovery using headless browser orchestration and LLM classification

projects.title: DevOps & AWS Infrastructure Toolkit
projects.description: A comprehensive toolkit of automated infrastructure configurations. Includes Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, AWS CloudFormation & CDK templates, API Gateway integrations, AWS Beanstalk orchestration, and Kinesis real-time data streaming.
projects.outcome: Streamlined multi-environment deployments using modern DevOps practices

projects.title: Containerized Django AWS Deployment
projects.description: A production-ready Django application packaged with Docker and configured for highly scalable cloud architectures. Includes AWS Infrastructure as Code templates and Ansible automation playbooks to execute seamless cloud deployments and configuration management.
projects.outcome: Implemented reliable production deployment orchestration with Ansible and Docker containerization
